description: The epic's constitutional act, and the reason the order is record-before-code (PR-017 procedure, AB5): publish the record set fixed by docs/precedent-research/synthesis-addendum-ii-spec.md through the real precedent.py CLI, BEFORE any enforcement code or reader exists. Part A records enact the buildable-now DIRECTIVEs (two currencies, displacement bridge, Phase A ledger-only with the sybil caveat and uniform burden, the Phase B identity gate, the load-bearing citation as provisional doctrine with a decay clock, the pre-registered Phase B weighting, the A.9 refusals). Part C records are RECORDS ONLY and FUTURE-BINDING (AB1): territorial law with the founding-domain delimitation, the sovereign cell charter, and the Westphalia KPI with the operator baseline - they bind future construction and authorize no cell, registry or charter now. The Brussels-effect parking lives in the Part C record's dicta and nowhere else. You publish against the CURRENTLY SHIPPED CLI: no record may use a flag that does not exist yet.
acceptance_criteria: OWNS EXACTLY the NEW records you mint under .harness/precedents/ (PR-018 and higher; the live registry holds PR-001..PR-017 as of 2026-08-12). Do NOT edit any existing record UNLESS T-368 ruled RETROFIT for PR-009 and assigned that edit here - in which case name the authorizing record and the exact field changed in your handoff. Do NOT edit .harness/bin/precedent.py, PRECEDENT.md, INTERPRETIVE-CODE.md, .harness/precedents/README.md, or any test file.

NEVER HAND-WRITE A RECORD. Every record is minted by running the real CLI. A hand-created or hand-edited JSON file under .harness/precedents/ is an automatic REJECT: the entire point is that the layer amends itself through its own protocol, and a hand-written record is the silent divergence the layer exists to forbid.

PUBLISH THE LEDGER T-368 FIXED, one record per row, in the spec's order. For EVERY addendum DIRECTIVE section (A.2, A.3, A.4, A.5, A.6.3, A.7, A.9, C.3, C.4, C.5) state in the handoff which record enacts it or which record subsumes it. A silently skipped DIRECTIVE is a defect. If the spec's ledger omits a DIRECTIVE, hand off BLOCKED naming the gap rather than inventing the record text yourself.

EXACT PUBLISH COMMANDS (P-025): quote in the handoff the COMPLETE `python3 .harness/bin/precedent.py publish --agent <you> --task T-369 ...` line for each record exactly as run, with no elision and no ellipsis, so a verifier can paste it and re-run it in a temp root. REGISTRY-WIDE CHECKS with the MEASURED PRE-EPIC BASELINE quoted so you cannot absorb a regression: before this epic, `python3 .harness/bin/precedent.py conflicts` prints '1 conflict finding(s) across 17 record(s)' - PR-001's dangling P-023 token, the layer correctly reporting a real constitutional gap - and exits 3; `python3 .harness/bin/precedent.py cite --all` prints '1 of 94 citation(s) dangling' and exits 3.
